about.description:
This plugin contains the SlicedNonbondedForce class, a variant of
OpenMM's NonbondedForce. By partitioning all particles among disjoint
subsets, the total potential energy becomes a linear combination of
contributions from pairs of subsets.
about.summary: An OpenMM plugin for slicing nonbonded interactions

test.commands:
pytest -v python/tests/TestSlicedNonbondedForce.py || exit 1
cd ${CONDA_PREFIX}/share/openmm-nonbonded-slicing/tests
ls -al
set +e
summary=""
exitcode=0
for f in Test*; do
  if [[ $f == *Cuda* || $f == *OpenCL* ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  echo "Running $f..."
  ./${f}
  thisexitcode=$?
  summary+="\n${f}: "
  if [[ $thisexitcode == 0 ]]; then summary+="OK"; else summary+="FAILED"; fi
  ((exitcode+=$thisexitcode))
done
echo "-------"
echo "Summary"
echo "-------"
echo -e "${summary}"
exit $exitcode

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.3.0" %}
{% set vkfft_version = "1.3.4" %}

package:
  name: openmm-nonbonded-slicing
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/craabreu/openmm-nonbonded-slicing/archive/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 03aee12d7a20a7d061de73313283e15a873a91680b5e2d5385cff0ab1b308507
  # Header-only FFT library that upstream's CMake would otherwise clone at configure time
  - url: https://github.com/DTolm/VkFFT/archive/refs/tags/v{{ vkfft_version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: b61055393adb3adc79009fe12401cbfbbdfba584e665e9c35fcbf4b32fb31f30
    folder: vkfft

build:
  number: 0
  string: cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}py{{ CONDA_PY }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  string: cpu_py{{ CONDA_PY }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
  skip: true  # [win or aarch64]
  # OpenMM ships only CUDA-enabled builds on linux-64
  skip: true  # [linux64 and cuda_compiler_version in (undefined, 'None')]
  rpaths:
    - lib/
  # The CUDA driver library comes from the system's NVIDIA driver, not from a conda package
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - "*/libcuda.so*"  # [linux]

requirements:
  build:
    - python                                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}     # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - setuptools                             # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - swig                                   # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - openmm                                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ compiler('cuda') }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cmake
    - make
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    # The Python wrapper must be generated with the same SWIG version as OpenMM's
    # (see conda_build_config.yaml, where openmm and swig are zipped)
    - swig
    - openmm
    - opencl-headers
    - ocl-icd  # [linux]
    - khronos-opencl-icd-loader  # [osx]
    {% if cuda_compiler_version != "None" %}
    - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}
    - cuda-driver-dev
    - cuda-cudart-dev
    - cuda-nvrtc-dev
    - libcufft-dev
    {% endif %}
  run:
    - python
    - {{ pin_compatible('openmm', max_pin='x.x') }}
    - ocl-icd  # [linux]
    - ocl-icd-system  # [linux]
    - khronos-opencl-icd-loader  # [osx]
    - ocl_icd_wrapper_apple      # [osx]

test:
  source_files:
    - python/tests/TestSlicedNonbondedForce.py
  requires:
    - pytest
  imports:
    - nonbondedslicing
  commands: |
    pytest -v python/tests/TestSlicedNonbondedForce.py || exit 1
    cd ${CONDA_PREFIX}/share/openmm-nonbonded-slicing/tests
    ls -al
    set +e
    summary=""
    exitcode=0
    for f in Test*; do
      if [[ $f == *Cuda* || $f == *OpenCL* ]]; then
        continue
      fi
      echo "Running $f..."
      ./${f}
      thisexitcode=$?
      summary+="\n${f}: "
      if [[ $thisexitcode == 0 ]]; then summary+="OK"; else summary+="FAILED"; fi
      ((exitcode+=$thisexitcode))
    done
    echo "-------"
    echo "Summary"
    echo "-------"
    echo -e "${summary}"
    exit $exitcode

about:
  home: https://github.com/craabreu/openmm-nonbonded-slicing
  summary: 'An OpenMM plugin for slicing nonbonded interactions'
  description: |
    This plugin contains the SlicedNonbondedForce class, a variant of
    OpenMM's NonbondedForce. By partitioning all particles among disjoint
    subsets, the total potential energy becomes a linear combination of
    contributions from pairs of subsets.
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.md
    - vkfft/LICENSE
  doc_url: https://craabreu.github.io/openmm-nonbonded-slicing
  dev_url: https://github.com/craabreu/openmm-nonbonded-slicing

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - craabreu
    - jananzhu
